question: Given a publication PID, find all articles that cite it plus those cited in the publication itself.
expected_answer: PIDs of articles in either citation direction; decide whether direction must be returned.
notes: The publication PID scheme must be identifiable. Do not assume citation is symmetric or transitive.

question: Given an author, return all documents where one of his/her work is cited.
expected_answer: PIDs of documents citing at least one work authored by the given person.
notes: Pilot assumption: identify the author with a PID; name disambiguation is outside this pilot.

question: Give me the references of all the available datasets that I can find in this federation of graphs.
notes: Pilot interpretation: references means identifiers; available means described in a participating graph, not necessarily downloadable.

question: Give me the list of identifiers of all the available datasets that I can find in this federation of graphs related to topic X and keywords Y.
expected_answer: Dataset identifiers matching the requested topic and keywords.
notes: Retain the distinction between topic concepts and keyword literals for this pilot. All/any keyword matching and label matching rules require review; do not invent OWL restrictions for them.
